site.title2: Pattaya FloodWatch — water status, map and help in Pattaya City
site.desc2: Live overview of flooding in Pattaya City: standing-water map, road closures, detours, ways to report and ask for help, plus hotlines you can call right away.
site.src: Data — water & rain: HII (ThaiWater) · weather forecast: Open-Meteo · base map: OpenStreetMap
site.disclaim: Prototype for trial use — not an official Pattaya City channel
